description: Unit test code for SbCPUFeaturesGet function, testing CPU feature detection on Raspberry Pi 4 (64-bit). It includes validation functions for ARM, MIPS, and x86 features and a test case 'SunnyDay' that checks the CPU features returned by SbCPUFeaturesGet.

methods.name: ExpectArmInvalid
methods.description: Checks that all ARM CPU feature fields are set to invalid values.

methods.name: ExpectMipsInvalid
methods.description: Checks that MIPS-specific CPU features are invalid.

methods.name: ExpectX86Invalid
methods.description: Checks that x86 CPU features are invalid and vendor string is empty.
